newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sydney Paralympic organisers change dates.
newsitem.headline: Sydney Paralympic organisers change dates.

text.p: The dates for the Sydney 2000 Paralympic Games have been changed after an analysis of problems encountered at this year's Atlanta Games, Paralympic officials announced on Friday.
The Paralympics, which had been set for October 14-24, have been changed to October 18-29, Sydney Paralympic Organising Committee (SPOC) chief executive Lois Appleby said in a statement.
"The transition period between the 1996 Olympic and Paralaympic Games was totally inadequate and seriously impacted on the running of the Paralympic Games," Appleby said.
Organisers of the Atlanta Paralaympics had complained that, in some cases, they had been given only two days after the end of the Olympics to have facilities ready for their own Games.
"The tight set-up period was particularly evident in the (athletes') village, where the organisers had only 48 hours to move from one event to the other," Appleby said.
The Sydney 2000 Olympics will run from September 15 to October 1.
